main_text.head: PLEBEM NE CONCITATO
main_text.p: [Woodcut: owl perched on a column with scales, city and fields behind; not transcribed as text.]
main_text.l: Quæritur immani nece cur perit hicce vel ille?:
In promptu causa est: seditiosus erat.
Crede, magistratus frustra non promicat ense:

page.notes: The woodcut is an emblem picture (owl on a column between scales, fields of soldiers, city in background); described only. The side label "Noctuam" at lower right is set in italic black type and is treated as a note, not as a catchword. The verse line "Quæritur ... hicce vel ille?:" and the line ending "ense:" carry printed colons as shown. Some letters in the verse are slightly blurred; "vnquam" and "promicat" are read as printed.
